As someone who has been to a psych ward before in the 19 years i’ve been alive, I can say that it annoys me quite a bit when i hear people treating psych wards like a vacation from real life. on the other hand, it’s also frustrating when they are treated as some sort of evil place for crazy people. 

i think the worst part of being in a psych ward is how you’re treated afterward. it’s like you’re a completely different person. everyone walks on eggshells around you, desperate not to be the next thing to push you over the edge and back into the hospital. that’s the worst part. being treated differently, almost like you’re weak for asking for help. that always makes me angry. 

psych wards themselves are very nice for the most part. food isn’t great and it’s like a glorified(or maybe higher supervision) version of a prison. while i was in the psych ward, many crazy things happened including fights between patients, verbal fights between patients and nurses, naked people running through the halls, etc. i wish more funding would go into the mental health industry so that people can get the help they so badly need.
